svg.text: The piece is a chain: it builds up the PID method step by step, then fans that method out across a cluster of
empirical findings, before narrowing back to practical limits and a closing summary.

g.text: From method to findings and back
Each stage builds on the one above; the empirical section (one region) applies the method in several directions at once
before the piece narrows to limits and a summary.

g.title: New recording data need new analysis tools — → spya-yb735k
Mutual information and transfer entropy track information flow — → spya-ygkzd8
But flow alone can't show how inputs are combined — → spya-dhy39x
g.text: But flow alone can't show how

g.title: Whole ≠ sum of parts: redundancy vs synergy — → spya-u0wm5e
Lattice of information atoms, via Möbius inversion — → spya-k378fv
No single agreed redundancy measure — → spya-d2quz5
Rich-club neurons hold most of the synergy — → spya-e3ghxj
Recurrent links raise synergy; feedback doesn't — → spya-p8by2y
Correlated inputs boost synergy, up to a point — → spya-zfs2z7
In behaving monkeys, synergy shifts with task demands — → spya-aqcngt
Caveats: cultures, bivariate TE — → spya-vjzxxm
Practical limits: data type, sample size, tools, lattice explosion — → spya-kmgwhs
Future: local and multi-target PID — → spya-zz5xxs

g.title: Joint info from two sources need not equal the sum of each alone — → spya-u0wm5e

g.title: Excess = synergy; shortfall = redundancy — → spya-e94ury
Two-parent case: four unknowns, three equations — underdetermined — → spya-y7wdb7
General case: sources arranged in a partial-information lattice — → spya-k378fv
Möbius inversion recovers each unique information atom — → spya-aft2rx
Which redundancy measure to use? — → spya-d2quz5
No universal answer — choice depends on data type — → spya-rc76qn

g.text: One empirical setup feeds three parallel findings about where synergy concentrates, a caveat on their scope, and a
further finding from a different (behaving-animal) setting.

g.title: Cortical culture recordings decomposed into thousands of triads — → spya-cc282b
Rich-club neurons (minority) hold most network synergy — ~40% of neurons account for ~88% of network-wide synergy. — → spya-e3ghxj
Recurrent connections raise synergy; feedback does not — → spya-p8by2y
Synergy peaks at intermediate source correlation, then falls — → spya-zfs2z7
Caveats: bivariate TE bias; cultures, not living behaving brains — → spya-vjzxxm
In behaving macaques, synergy gives way to redundancy during movement execution — → spya-aqcngt
